transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I'm... well, I'm just trying to find someone who will actually take me seriously. It's about my job. For over a year now, the new ticket rotation and these security audits... they're being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps pulling up logs and telling me it's just policy, but... anyway, that's why I'm here.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?
No. I haven't. I mean, why would I? That's... that's not what this is about. I'm just here because of the situation at work.
Have you noticed similar issues with trusting people outside of your job, like with family or friends?

No. Not at all. My personal life is... it's fine. 

Outside of the issue with the ticket rotation and those audits, everything is normal. I keep the house in order, pay the bills... help my wife. Even at work, I handle the technical parts of my job perfectly well. No one is saying my actual work is sloppy or disorganized. 

So, no. It's just that one specific situation.
